                                                          AI Features/Opting Out of AI Features

                                                          About noai.duckduckgo.com

                                                          DuckDuckGo's approach to AI is to provide private, useful, and optional AI features — including chat and search instant answers — to people who want the productivity benefits of AI without the privacy risks.

                                                          We provide settings that allow you to customize how much or how little AI you want as a part of your DuckDuckGo experience. In addition, we also provide a version of DuckDuckGo Search that automatically turns all AI features off and filters out as much AI-generated content as possible (as best we can).

                                                          If you'd prefer an AI-free DuckDuckGo Search experience, start your searches on noai.duckduckgo.com instead of on duckduckgo.com. Searching on noai.duckduckgo.com works the same as search on duckduckgo.com, except all AI features are turned off and AI-generated images are filtered out of results by default.

                                                          Here's the full list of content and features blocked on noai.duckduckgo.com:

                                                          • Search Assist
                                                          • Duck.ai
                                                          • AI-generated images

                                                          We also offer No-AI browser extensions for Chrome and Firefox that set your default search to the DuckDuckGo AI-free experience and filter out AI-generated images from search results.

                                                          • Get the No-AI Search extension for Firefox
                                                          • Get the No-AI Search extension for Chrome

                                                          If we add new AI products and features in the future, noai.duckduckgo.com will remain a way to search privately on DuckDuckGo without AI.

https://duckduckgo.com/about.visible_text: About DuckDuckGo Main navigation menu closed Menu We’re about data protection, not data collection. We're the independent, free browser that actively protects your personal information. Search, browse, and use AI privately, keeping your information to yourself and away from hackers, scammers, and privacy-invasive companies. Unlike others, all our AI features are optional. Learn More About DuckDuckGo Trusted for Over a Decade Join the millions of people that choose DuckDuckGo over Chrome and other browsers. 3B Monthly Searches And Growing Fast 9M Monthly Downloads On Mobile & Desktop 4.8 Average Rating On Apple & Google Play 335 Team Members Making it Happen Take control of your personal information. The DuckDuckGo browser is designed for data protection, not data collection. Our browsing protections help stop your data from being collected and our built-in search engine never tracks your searches. Plus, it blocks cookie pop-ups and invasive ads, including on videos. Available on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android . 2010 2011 2012 2013 2014 2016 2018 2020 2022 2023 2024 2025 Our Story of Protection Since 2008, we’ve expanded what we do to protect you no matter where you go on the Internet. Check out our story. 1 of 31 Our Story of Protection Since 2008, we’ve expanded what we do to protect you no matter where you go on the Internet. Check out our story. We Hatched DuckDuckGo began as an idea for a better search engine experience. We hatched out of a few servers in a dusty basement. September 25, 2008 Launch! Within the year, DuckDuckGo was announced to the Hacker News and reddit communities. We made it out with only minor troll scars. September 25, 2008 Anonymous We decided to make a bold move and not track your search history. Tracking is creepy. March 15, 2010 The Billboard We told the world “Google tracks you. We don’t.” with a billboard in their backyard. Hello, World! January 11, 2011 Launched Charitable Donations Program We rely on a lot of great projects to keep our wings flapping. So we started giving back to support new and innovative tech projects, strengthening our commitment to raising the standard of trust online. February 26, 2011 Team Member #1 For years, our founder Gabriel was the only full-timer. Caine Tighe changed all that, coming on board as our first official team member. November 30, 2011 Headquarters We finally moved out of Gabriel’s basement into our fortress in Paoli, PA. It really looks like a castle! December 1, 2011 Redesign Our first major visual overhaul introduced a new design that made you not want to close your browser the second you saw our results page. January 16, 2012 1 Billion Searches! We reached the incredible milestone of 1 billion anonymous searches. July 18, 2013 Team Member #10 The big guys have thousands more team members than us, and so everyone at DuckDuckGo is an essential member of the team. Welcome to our 10th team member! March 17, 2014 Reimagined DuckDuckGo launches a redesigned search engine with a refined look and a focus on smarter answers. And, of course, we still don’t track you. May 19, 2014 Safari Apple begins including DuckDuckGo in Safari, with the launch of iOS 8 and OS X Yosemite. Wow, cool! September 17, 2014 Firefox Mozilla adds DuckDuckGo as a built-in search option to Firefox. Thank you! Do you think we’ll ever get into Chrome? November 10, 2014 10 Billion Searches! We concluded 2016 with over four billion anonymous searches served, surpassing a cumulative count of ten billion! December 31, 2016 Privacy Beyond Search We extended our privacy protection beyond the search box with the launch of our new mobile app & browser extension, available on all major platforms. January 23, 2018 $1 Million Donation Milestone We reached $1 million in donations to help support organizations that share our vision to raise the standard of trust online. April 10, 2018 50 Billion Searches! In the last two years, we've flown from 25 billion searches to a whopping 50 billion! June 20, 2020 Team Member #100 The pond’s getting fuller! With our 100th team member joining the flock, we’re adding more quack to our team spirit. July 1, 2020 100 Billion Searches! Over the past one and a half years, we’ve doubled our all-time searches to 100 billion! January 13, 2022 Privacy on Mac We brought our browser experience to desktops and laptops with the launch of the DuckDuckGo Private Browser on Mac. April 12, 2022 Email Protection We launched Email Protection — our free email forwarding service that removes multiple types of hidden email trackers and lets you create private email addresses on the fly. August 25, 2022 Privacy on Windows We launched the DuckDuckGo Private Browser on Windows. June 22, 2023 15th Anniversary! We celebrated 15 years of DuckDuckGo, now offering comprehensive privacy protections used by tens of millions of people to protect their everyday online activities, from searching to browsing, emailing, and more. September 25, 2023 Private Sync & Backup We introduced the ability to privately and securely sync and backup bookmarks, passwords, and Email Protection settings between DuckDuckGo browsers on phones, tablets, and computers. February 15, 2024 DuckDuckGo Subscription We launched the DuckDuckGo subscription (formerly Privacy Pro) — our subscription service with VPN, Personal Information Removal, and Identity Theft Restoration! April 11, 2024 Duck.ai We launched Duck.ai — a private way to access popular AI chatbots. June 6, 2024 Investments We announced we're investing in privacy-respecting companies that are raising the standard of trust online. October 23, 2024 $6M Mark in Charitable Donations To date, we’ve donated a total of $6.9 million in donations, reflecting our ongoing dedication to supporting organizations and raising the standard of trust online. December 3, 2024 Subscription + Duck.ai We added a new benefit to the DuckDuckGo subscription — support for advanced AI models in Duck.ai. August 27, 2025 $8M Mark in Charitable Donations For our fifteenth year of donations, we donated $1.1M to benefit 29 organizations that share our vision of raising the standard of trust online. September 30, 2025 From Our Blog At SpreadPrivacy.com, we publish privacy education, tips, and original research, along with DuckDuckGo news. That's why millions of people choose DuckDuckGo over Chrome and other browsers to search and browse online. Our built-in search engine is like Google but never tracks your searches, and our browser blocks ads, trackers, and cookies that collect your data. function beforeBody() {
    if (/^\/share\//.test(location.pathname)) {
        const meta = document.createElement('meta');
        meta.name = 'robots';
        meta.content = 'noindex, nofollow';
        document.head.appendChild(meta);
    }

    document.documentElement?.classList.remove('no-js');
    const osDark = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches;
    const native = window.__nativeStorageEntries;
    const isDesktopElectron = window.navigator?.duckduckgo?.platform === 'electron';
    const stored = (native && native.setting_kae) || localStorage.setting_kae;
    const isDark = stored === 'd' || (stored !== '-1' && osDark);
    document.documentElement.style.colorScheme = isDark ? 'dark' : 'light';
    document.documentElement.dataset.theme = isDark ? 'dark' : 'light';

    if (isDesktopElectron) {
        document.documentElement.dataset.desktopElectron = '';
    }

    // Expose the OS so CSS can target OS-specific quirks. Match desktop
    // Windows while excluding Windows Phone / Mobile.
    const ua = window.navigator.userAgent;
    const isWindows = /Windows|Win32|Win64/i.test(ua) && !/windows phone|windows mobile/i.test(ua);
    if (isWindows) {
        document.documentElement.dataset.os = 'windows';
    }

    try {
        const sidebarCollapsed =
            (native && native.duckaiSidebarCollapsed) || localStorage.getItem('duckaiSidebarCollapsed');
        if (sidebarCollapsed === 'true') {
            document.documentElement.dataset.sidebarCollapsed = '';
        }
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        if (params.get('native-input') === 'true') {
            document.documentElement.dataset.hideChatInputPlaceholder = '';
        }
    } catch (e) {}
}

</script>

    width: 100%;
    max-width: 640px; /* --duckai-chat-max-width-empty-state */
    margin: 0 auto;
    height: 100px; /* --ds-space-x10(40) + --ds-space-x15(60) = 100px */
    display: flex;
    padding: 12px; /* --ds-space-x03 */
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    align-items: stretch;
    gap: 12px; /* --ds-space-x03 */
    background-color: var(--sk-input-bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--sk-input-border);
    border-radius: 24px; /* --ds-radius-x06 */
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* Top row inside input — takes remaining height */
.sk-input-top {
    flex: 1;
}

.sk-input-pill {
    width: 30%;
    height: 100%;
    margin-top: 4px;
    border-radius: 9999px; /* --ds-radius-full */
    background-color: var(--sk-action-bg);
}

/* Action buttons row inside input */
.sk-input-actions {
    height: 32px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-self: stretch;
}

.sk-input-actions-left {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
}

.sk-action-btn {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: var(--sk-action-bg);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Disclaimer spacer — reserves vertical space below the input.
 * Matches .footerDisclaimer padding + approximate single-line text height. */
.sk-disclaimer-spacer {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 938px; /* --duckai-chat-max-width */
    margin: auto;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding: 8px 56px; /* --ds-space-x02(8) --ds-space-x14(56) */
    min-height: 13px; /* ≈ one line of label text (12.3px) */
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

/* ModeEntryPoints spacer — hidden on desktop (matches mode-entry-points.module.css .container display:none) */
.sk-entry-points {
    display: none;
}

/* Mobile/tablet: input centered vertically (matches emptyStateContainer flex-grow:1 + justify-content:center) */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
    .loader {
        padding-right: 0; /* no layout padding-right on mobile */
    }
    .sk-empty-state {
        /* flex: 1 1 auto so the lockup's intrinsic height participates in
         * free-space distribution; the default flex: 1 (= 1 1 0%) would treat
         * .sk-lockup as zero-basis and leave the input position unchanged. */
        flex: 1 1 auto;
        justify-content: flex-end; /* keep lockup close to the input during first paint */
    }
    .sk-lockup {
        width: 112px;
        height: 112px;
    }
    .sk-input-area {
        max-width: 700px; /* --duckai-chat-max-width-mobile (footer max-width) */
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: 0 12px; /* --ds-space-x03 = 12px (--duckai-chat-left/right-padding mobile) */
    }
    .sk-input {
        max-width: none; /* input fills the 700px footer area, not capped at 640px */
        min-height: 98px; /* mobile: x10(40) + x14(56) + 2px border = 98px */
    }
    .sk-entry-points {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 16px; /* --ds-space-x04 (matches ModeEntryPoints container margin-top) */
        height: 26px;
    }
    .sk-disclaimer-spacer {
        flex: 1; /* bottom spacer: balances top spacer to center the input */
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        min-height: 0;
        max-width: none;
    }
}

/* ===== Breathing animation ===== */
.sk-sidebar-icon,
.sk-sidebar-title,
.sk-lockup,
.sk-input {
    animation: skeleton-breath 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* ===== Noscript message styles ===== */
.noscript-container {
    width: 100vw;
    height: 100vh;
    display: grid;
    place-content: center;
    padding: 16px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    text-align: center;
}

.noscript-text {
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1.4;
    color: #111;
}

/* Electron: hide sidebar header (behind window controls / traffic lights) */
[data-desktop-electron] .sk-sidebar-header {
    visibility: hidden;
}

/* Electron: make skeleton sidebar draggable (visibility:hidden on header blocks drag, so target parent) */
[data-desktop-electron] .sk-sidebar {
    -webkit-app-region: drag;
}

/* Electron: make skeleton toolbar draggable (mirrors React's electronDragRegion on top-toolbar) */
[data-desktop-electron] .sk-toolbar {
    -webkit-app-region: drag;
}

/* Hide the chat input skeleton when the native app provides its own input
 * (no web form will mount). Set pre-paint by inline.js so the input area
 * is never laid out and there's no flash. Targets .sk-input-area so the
 * input box AND the mobile entry-points strip collapse together; the
 * surrounding flex spacers keep the layout centered. */
[data-hide-chat-input-placeholder] .sk-input-area {
    display: none;
}

/* Hide loader when JS is disabled */
.no-js .loader {
    display: none;
}
